epoch_note: All 584 selected PHP/config inputs match the original. Ancillary frontend/build changes are recorded separately. The lost historical diagnostic reference is not asserted identical; this series creates a fresh exact pass16 baseline reference.
memory_note: Dedicated scope memory.peak includes processes and charged file cache; not PHP heap or a sum of largest-child RSS values.
